item.text: Dear Volunteer Coordinator, I’m looking forward to helping during the busy exhibition weekend. I wanted to ask whether I could be assigned to a quieter role, such as assisting in the archives, information desk, or another less crowded area. I’m happy to contribute wherever needed, but I work most effectively in calmer settings and would appreciate an assignment that allows me to remain focused and helpful. Thank you for considering my request, and I’m glad to support the museum.
